title: KDE Plasma 4 desktop
lede: Free-software desktop of the late 2000s with glassy widgets, glowing bubbles on teal, and a wallpaper of wet grass.
summary: Translucent widgets, teal bubble wallpaper, dew on grass. KDE, 2008 onward.

evidence.note: Inspected the GPL-licensed screenshot [File:Plasma Workspaces.png](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Plasma_Workspaces.png) (1652 × 996, 2011) and stored a 1600 px copy.

styles.note: Wikipedia uses this screenshot as its lead example of the style: glass widgets, bubbles, water drops, and grass.

context: KDE Plasma 4 is the fourth generation of KDE’s workspaces (desktop, netbook, and tablet). KDE 4.0 was released in January 2008. From KDE 4.3 the default Air theme “predominates in transparency and white.” [Wikipedia: KDE Plasma 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/KDE_Plasma_4).

The lead image of the Wikipedia Frutiger Aero article is this screenshot, captioned: many interfaces from the 2000s “exemplify the Frutiger Aero style.” [Wikipedia: Frutiger Aero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frutiger_Aero).
The screenshot comes from a KDE developer’s blog post of March 2011 ([notmart.org](http://notmart.org/blog/2011/03/towards_a_declarative_plasma_co/)).
observed: A teal-to-dark-cyan wallpaper holds glowing, translucent bubbles and rings.
An image-viewer window shows a photograph of green grass blades covered in water drops.
Widgets (weather, contacts, launchers) are semi-transparent dark panels with rounded corners, soft glows, and glossy icons.
A tablet-style shell uses a magenta-to-orange gradient with large white rounded-square buttons.
interpretation: This is the style outside Microsoft and Apple: an open-source desktop reaching for the same glass, water, and dew imagery. It shows the look was a period consensus, not one company’s brand.
borrow: Put small content panels on a dark translucent fill with a 1 px light edge and rounded corners.
Use soft out-of-focus bubbles or rings as background texture instead of noise or patterns.

images.alt: Composite screenshot of KDE Plasma 4: a teal desktop with glowing bubbles and app icons, a translucent weather and contacts panel on a magenta gradient, and an image viewer showing wet grass blades.
